name: snarl-sopi-backend
description: Snarl and Sopi operator backend v6.0: aisle enable/disable for customers, done the right way. Per the kiosk SDK findings, Weimi isEnable is unwritable and irrelevant for a kiosk-run machine; the real lever is the kiosks local disabledAisles set. Backend now carries disabledAisles in the config response (durable source of truth the kiosk seeds from) and adds the set_aisle_enabled command (aisle, enabled) which persists the change to disabledAisles and touches config for instant effect. Restock rows get a stop-selling / enable-for-sale toggle plus the existing clear-fault action; all bays including broken and disabled remain visible and restockable. Cumulative over v5.99.
